Quantum 1.42.0 was certified on 2026-10-18. It pins **nucleus v1.33.0**, **quark v1.17.0** and **orbit v1.20.1**, with 28 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.41.0: nucleus goes from v1.32.0 to v1.33.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.19.3 to v1.20.1 (minor) and quark stays at v1.17.0. 21 sibling modules change version.
